title: Baton Rouge Women, Cloche Hats Rocks - Antique 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
EWING INC.
KODAK DEPT.
BATON ROUGE, LA.
description: Three young women wearing soft cloche hats, tailored jackets, and sweaters sit together atop a sunny rocky outcrop. Smiling gently toward the camera, their attire and adventurous outing reflect the expanding freedom and love of outdoor recreation enjoyed by young women in the Roaring Twenties. The reverse side bears a purple commercial developing stamp from 'Ewing Inc. Kodak Dept. Baton Rouge, LA.' along with remnants of black album mounting paper.
